post_score_remediation.root_cause: JetBrains Mono at 24px with 0.10em tracking advances 16.8px per character; every affected knockout plate and chip had been hand-sized at roughly 14px per character. Nothing in the engine could see the result: render.py's overlap detector inspects DOM text line boxes only, and every defect was SVG text against an SVG rect, against canvas artwork, or under a DOM block.
engine_upgrade: render.py now measures every SVG <text> against the <rect> painted under it and reports containment (out.svg_plates).

render.py now also reports the two mirror cases: an opaque <rect> painted AFTER the text in document order, and an opaque DOM element composited above the whole <svg>, sampled with elementsFromPoint across the label's own box.
qa.py grades all three as FAIL (WARN when the label is data-decorative or marked data-overlap-ok).
Verified against a purpose-built ground-truth slide carrying one spill case, one painted-over case and one correct control: both defects were reported, the control stayed silent.
